sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Laboratory"."ID" AS e, "Patient"."SEX" AS g, AVG("Laboratory"."RBC") AS m1, AVG(("Laboratory"."PLT" - "Laboratory"."WBC")) AS m2, (CAST(AVG("Laboratory"."RBC") AS REAL) / AVG(("Laboratory"."PLT" - "Laboratory"."WBC"))) AS m3 FROM "Laboratory" JOIN "Patient" ON "Patient"."ID" = "Laboratory"."ID"  GROUP BY "Laboratory"."ID", "Patient"."SEX"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT AVG("s2"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s2"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s2"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s2"
